about: The 5 nearest rows for 3 questions, as searchChunks returns them for the question's shop and current versions, recorded from the ai-support data. Distances are rounded to 3 decimals.

q-dw-desk-lamp.question: How long do I have to return a desk lamp for a refund?

rows.content: Refund policy, how long you have: You can ask for a refund within 60 days of delivery, as long as the item can be sold again.
Returning assembled furniture, desks and chairs: Office chairs and desks can be returned within 30 days, even after assembly. Take the item apart, and pack the parts in the original box.
Returning assembled furniture, pickup: For desks over 25 kg, we book a courier pickup. The pickup fee of $25 is taken from the refund.
Refund policy, how refunds are paid: Refunds go to the original payment method within 7 business days after the item passes inspection.
Shipping, delivery times: Small items arrive in 2 to 4 business days. Desks and chairs ship by freight, and take 5 to 10 business days.

q-refund-window.question: How many days do I have to ask for a refund?

rows.content: Refund policy, how long you have: You can ask for a refund within 30 days of delivery. The 30 days start on the day the carrier marks the order as delivered.

Refund policy, how refunds are paid: Refunds are paid to the original payment method within 5 business days after we receive the item. Shipping costs are refunded only when the item arrived damaged or wrong.
Warranty, making a claim: Send the order number and a short video of the fault from the Orders page. We repair or replace the appliance within 14 days.
Gift cards, expiry and refunds: Gift cards don't expire. They can't be exchanged for cash or refunded.
Refund policy, items we can't refund: Gift cards, opened coffee beans, and items marked final sale can't be refunded.

q-no-answer.question: Do you match a lower price from another store?

rows.content: Gift cards, checking the balance: Enter the gift card code on the Gift cards page to see its balance. You can use one card across several orders.
Damaged or wrong items, what we do: We send a free replacement, or a full refund including shipping if the item is out of stock. You don't need to send the broken item to us.
Gift cards, buying one: Digital gift cards come in amounts from $10 to $200, and arrive by email within an hour.
Payment, a charge that appears twice: When you place an order, your bank may show a pending hold and the final charge. The hold disappears within 3 to 5 business days.
Returns, used items: You can return a used item if it still works and is clean. Knives and cutting boards can only be returned unused.
